sloka: तं दृष्ट्वा निहतं सङ्ख्ये राक्षसास्ते समन्ततः ।व्यद्रवन्सहिताः सर्वे क्रोशमानाः परस्परम् ।विद्राव्यमाणा वसुना राक्षसा नावतस्थिरे ।। ७.२७.५० ।।
transliteration: taṁ dṛṣṭvā nihataṁ saṅkhye rākṣasāste samantataḥ ।vyadravansahitāḥ sarve krośamānāḥ parasparam ।vidrāvyamāṇā vasunā rākṣasā nāvatasthire ।। 7.27.50 ।।

translations.english: Having seen Sumali killed in battle, all those Rakshasas fled together from all sides, crying out to each other, and being driven away by Vasu, they could not stand firm.
